Rollenmanagement

Questions and answers

What is Rollenmanagement?

In this glossary, Rollenmanagement refers to: The process of defining, assigning, and controlling user roles and associated privileges within systems to enforce least privilege and separation of duties.

How is Rollenmanagement used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Effizientes Rollenmanagement beschränkt Zugriffsrechte auf das Notwendige für die Aufgabenerfüllung der Benutzer und unterstützt so Sicherheit und Compliance."

Definition

The process of defining, assigning, and controlling user roles and associated privileges within systems to enforce least privilege and separation of duties.

Operational example

Effective role management restricts access rights to only those necessary for users to perform their job functions, supporting security and compliance.
